items.title: Multi-Agent Systems: Beyond the Hype
items.desc: Everyone is building multi-agent systems, but the coordination overhead is killing performance. The new trend is hierarchical Swarm architecture where agents only communicate through a shared state manager, not directly.

items.title: Why your Agent is failing
items.desc: Agents fail because they lack long-term memory integration. Sticking everything in context window is outdated. Using graph databases for relational memory is the 2026 standard for autonomous agents.

items.title: Stop using JSON for Agent communication
items.desc: JSON parsing is slow and prone to hallucination breaks. Binary formats or structured schema-enforced communication (like Protobuf or strictly typed Yaml) are gaining traction in production agent deployments.
